phases.name: Codebase & Sanity Audit
tasks: Audited repo layout: monorepo root with portfolio-v1 (Next.js 16 + integrated LangGraph chat), portfolio-v2 (redesign), studio (Sanity Studio). No /ai-service existed; greenfield.

Audited env vars: .env.local already provides NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID=nl0qw78w, NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET=production, SANITY_API_READ_TOKEN, GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY, UPSTASH_VECTOR_URL, UPSTASH_VECTOR_TOKEN, REINDEX_SECRET. Spec names (SANITY_PROJECT_ID/SANITY_DATASET/SANITY_API_TOKEN) resolved via fallback mapping in config layer.

Audited Sanity schemas: 22 doc types in studio/schemaTypes (profile, project, experience, certification, certificationCategory, certificationIssuer, post, techStack, membership, recommendation, galleryImage, galleryCategory, category, author, blockContent, resume, seoSettings, siteSettings, mediaSettings, aboutSection, etc.).

Audited existing RAG stack (portfolio-v1/src/lib/rag): sentence chunker (512-token max, 64 overlap), gemini-embedding-001 via raw @google/generative-ai, Upstash Vector store (0.60 threshold, topK 5). Patterns ported and hardened for the sidecar.

Audited package deps: @langchain/langgraph 1.4.8, @langchain/core 1.2.4, @langchain/google-genai 2.2.0 (new, peers @langchain/core ^1.2.0), hono 4.12.33, @sanity/client 7.26.0, zod 3.25.76, vitest 4.1.10, tsx 4.23.1, typescript ~5.7.3 (typescript-eslint 8.65 caps at <6.1).
Decisions: Upstash Vector (existing provision), Hono server (SSE-friendly), endpoints-only integration (v1 UI untouched), vector IDs prefixed aisvc: to isolate from v1 index.

phases.name: Sanity Ingestion & Data Preprocessing Pipeline
tasks: Create zod-validated env config with dual-name fallback (repo convention + spec names).
Create Sanity client (apiVersion 2025-xx, read token) and typed GROQ queries for all knowledge doc types.
Implement PortableText/HTML to plain-text cleaner (normalize whitespace, strip markup, resolve block style prefixes).
Implement sentence-based chunker with overlap and token estimation.
Enrich chunk metadata: docId, docType, slug, category, _updatedAt, URL path, title.
Implement dedup/staleness pass: skip unchanged _updatedAt docs, drop vectors for removed docs.

phases.name: Vector Store & Gemini Embeddings Engine
tasks: Embeddings: GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings (text-embedding-004) via @langchain/google-genai.
Upstash Vector adapter mirroring v1 contract: upsert, query, delete, deleteByMetadata, reset, info.
Batch embedding with retry + rate limiting (p-queue style concurrency).
Full reindex + incremental reindex CLI entrypoint (REINDEX_SECRET-guarded).

phases.name: LangGraph Stateful RAG Agent Architecture
tasks: Typed graph state (messages, query, reformulatedQuery, intent, chunks, filteredChunks, response, citations, status).
Node 1 analyzeIntent: LLM intent classification + HyDE reformulation (gemini-2.5-flash).
Node 2 retrieve: vector search against Upstash using reformulated query embedding.
Node 3 relevanceFilter: score threshold, dedup, data quality verification, citation collection.
Node 4 generate: Gemini RAG synthesis with citation markers.
Node 5 validate: grounding/format check + citation mapping; no-answer fallback edge.

phases.name: Microservice HTTP / SSE Streaming API Server
tasks: Hono app with CORS, zod request validation, error middleware, rate limiting.
POST /api/chat: SSE (Accept: text/event-stream) + JSON mode; contract-compatible with v1 /api/chat events (status/token/tool_call/done/error).
Thread endpoints: GET/POST /api/chat/threads, GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/chat/threads/[id].
Admin: POST /api/admin/reindex (REINDEX_SECRET-guarded), GET /api/admin/stats.
GET /api/health, GET /api/stats for observability.

phases.name: Data Quality Benchmarks & Automated Testing
tasks: Vitest unit tests: cleaner, chunker, dedup, metadata enrichment.
LangGraph node tests with mocked LLM + vector store.
API route + SSE integration tests.
Benchmark script: retrieval hit-rate, faithfulness, citation accuracy.
PRD.json: all phases -> completed.
